data.title: Reitar Logtech Holdings Limited Announces US$3 Million Share Repurchase Program
data.description: On August 21, 2026, Reitar Logtech Holdings Limited, listed on NASDAQ as RITR, disclosed that their Board of Directors approved a share repurchase initiative. This program allows the company to buy back Class A ordinary shares worth up to $3 million in total value.

data.title: BJ’s Wholesale Club Continues Texas Expansion with New Location Planned for Tyler
data.description: BJ’s Wholesale Club (BJ) has revealed intentions to establish a new location in Tyler, Texas, as part of its expansion strategy following its recent entry into the Dallas-Fort Worth region. This move is aligned with BJ’s plan to open 25-30 new clubs every two years as part of their growth strategy. The company emphasizes its commitment to providing value, citing over 40 years of delivering savings and convenience to families.

data.title: The Atlantic hasn't seen any hurricanes this year but it's unclear if the calm will last. Consider flood insurance.
data.description: So far this year, there have been no hurricanes forming in the Atlantic basin, which is below the average number usually seen by this time. However, experts warn that the current low activity is not guaranteed to persist throughout the rest of the hurricane season.

data.title: Tesla, Waymo, Uber Granted Las Vegas Robotaxi Permits
data.description: Regulators in Nevada have officially granted permits for robotaxi services in Las Vegas to Tesla, Uber, and Google's Waymo, in addition to Amazon's Zoox. This decision, made on Thursday, allows these companies to operate autonomous vehicles in the city. The approval marks a significant milestone in the advancement of self-driving technology, with Tesla, Waymo, and Uber now poised to offer their services alongside Zoox in Las Vegas. This news has been covered by Investor's Business Daily.

data.title: Ross Stores Trounces Earnings, Set To Retake Buy Point
data.description: Shares of Ross Stores surged by 8% following an outstanding quarter that exceeded expectations on Wall Street. The company reported strong earnings, fueled by tariff refunds. This performance has positioned Ross Stores to potentially reclaim its buy point.

data.title: ASUS Unleashes Second Wave of Back-to-School Deals: Up to 50% Off Through September 10
data.description: ASUS is set to launch its second phase of Back-to-School promotions in Canada starting on August 21 and running until September 10. During this period, customers can enjoy heavy discounts on laptops, with prices starting as low as C$699 and savings of up to C$2,650 on selected models. Additionally, Chromebooks will be available for purchase starting at C$229. This limited-time offer provides an excellent opportunity for those in Canada looking to buy laptops or Chromebooks at significantly reduced prices before the school year begins.

data.title: Elevra Lithium Completes Binding Supply Agreement with Mangrove Lithium
data.description: Elevra Lithium Limited, a North American lithium producer, recently signed a binding Spodumene Concentrate Supply Agreement with Mangrove Lithium for the long-term supply of spodumene concentrate from North American Lithium in Québec. The agreement involves Elevra trading under the tickers ASX:ELV and NASDAQ:ELVR. This deal signifies a significant development for the industry, potentially impacting the supply chain. The specific details regarding the volume of supply and financial terms were not disclosed at this time. This agreement is a crucial step for Elevra in solidifying its position in the market and establishing itself as a key player in the lithium sector.

data.title: MicroCloud Hologram Inc. Announces Acquisition of 140,268 MSTR Shares Through Structured Note Investment Product, Continuing Its Strategic Investment in Bitcoin-Related Assets
data.description: MicroCloud Hologram Inc. has recently revealed its acquisition of 140,268 shares of MSTR through a Structured Note Investment Product. This move signifies a strategic investment by the company, reflecting its confidence in the potential growth and value of MSTR shares. The acquisition demonstrates MicroCloud Hologram Inc.'s commitment to expanding its portfolio and capitalizing on investment opportunities in the market. This acquisition of 140,268 MSTR shares showcases the company's strategic financial decision-making and aims to enhance its overall investment position.

data.title: Banuba Advances Real-Time AR Beauty With More Natural Skin Smoothing and Virtual Makeup
data.description: In Dubai, United Arab Emirates, Banuba has enhanced its real-time AR Beauty SDK by incorporating more advanced features for natural skin smoothing and virtual makeup application. This upgrade aims to provide users with a more realistic and confident appearance when on camera. The improvements in the SDK are designed to create a seamless on-camera experience, promoting a more polished and professional look.

data.title: CoStar Group Completes Acquisition of Zonda, Expanding into New Home Data, Analytics and Online Marketplaces
data.description: A provider of online real estate services CoStar Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: CSGP) based in ARLINGTON, Va. has successfully acquired Zonda for $800 million in cash. Zonda is recognized for new home construction data, homebuilder software, and residential real estate marketplaces. The acquisition bolsters CoStar Group's reach in the residential real estate sector and enhances its offerings with 3D digital twin technology.

data.title: Charmin is Officially Putting Bad Roommate Bathroom Behavior on Trial with the Forever Roll
data.description: In Cincinnati, shared living can lead to tension among roommates, especially when it comes to small things like replacing an empty toilet paper roll. Charmin is addressing this common issue with the Roommate Trials campaign, aiming to help roommates resolve disputes by introducing the Forever Roll. This extra-large roll ensures that no one is left stranded in the bathroom, emphasizing the importance of having a constant supply of toilet paper in shared living spaces. The campaign emphasizes the significance of this simple act of consideration in maintaining harmony among roommates.

data.title: MT Højgaard Holding A/S: MT Højgaard Danmark wins tender from Copenhagen Airport
data.description: A business unit of MT Højgaard Holding, MT Højgaard Danmark, has secured the initial phase of Copenhagen Airport's tender. The contract entails the planning, design, and construction of Baggage Factory East.

data.title: Binance's UAE employees have been cleared after questioning over third-party fund flows through a client account.
data.description: A spokesperson for Binance announced that following the provision of statements to authorities in the UAE regarding third-party fund movements through a client account, the employees have been cleared and released.
